checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan: port remaining lattice repository/analysis/snapshots, studio and domains modules, then switch the runtime entry point to Rust

impact_assessment.why: The prior rewrite task closed with the core, analysis, AI, experiments and first lattice parsers ported, but the outer layers and runtime entry point remain Python-only.
impact_assessment.benefits: A complete Rust runtime with no Python-only surface; the shared SQLite graph and parity harnesses let each layer be ported and verified independently.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: lattice schema v2 and studio/domain APIs must stay compatible; dependency: only declared crates; concurrency: ledger owned by opencode:rust-rewrite; state: existing graph files and lattice databases must remain readable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Port bounded modules with Python parity helpers, keep separate schema initialization for lattice stores, verify with cargo test plus direct hygiene/KB/secret/test scripts before each commit.
